_about: Deke content engine settings. Change approval_mode only on Denis's word.
_approval_modes: deke = (Denis, 2026-10-31) the Saturday run sends next week to Deke on a review page on dekesharon.com; he taps Approve or Skip per post; Sunday 21:00 the engine schedules everything not skipped; no answer means all of it goes out. explicit = batch waits for Denis's go (engine/approve.ps1 <week>). standing = the weekly run schedules the batch itself, at least 7 days ahead; Denis vetoes by deleting a post in Postiz.
_slots: Same weekly shape as the Oct 19 week that shipped and grew Skool 215 to 302. Day 0 = Monday. Times are local Toronto time; UTC is computed per date, so DST is handled.
rules: Only Deke's own words. Every reel is a clip of him speaking; every text post is built from something he said on camera or wrote, with the source recorded in the bank.
Anything that names a third party, shows other groups, or changes his meaning is needs_deke and never auto-posts.
